versions.changelog:
AI Gloves Designer 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches agentic AI service to generate customized gloves designs for print-on-demand (POD) and manufacturing-on-demand (MOD).
- Supports structured clothing parameters, reference images, custom text/logos, multi-view design generation, and interactive 3D design viewers.
- Provides an API for generating design drafts from prompts, images, and parameters.
- Integrates with the broader Craftsman Agent platform for supplier/manufacturing access.
